title: $\tau^2$-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
authors_zh: Victor Barres, Honghua Dong, Soham Ray, Xujie Si, Karthik Narasimhan
paper_type_zh: 双控制客服智能体评测环境与轨迹发布
best_for_zh: 研究环境智能体轨迹、用户模拟器、程序化 verifier 与 benchmark 版本审计的读者
one_line: tau2-bench releases a dual-control telecom environment with 114 sampled tasks from 2,285 generated compositions, state/action-grounded rewards, and full success/failure evaluation trajectories, but exact reuse requires a paper-era version pin.
tau2-bench 发布双控制客服环境，从 2,285 个 telecom 完整组合中抽取 114 个评测任务，并保留状态/动作反馈及成功与失败轨迹；准确复用必须固定论文时代的 v0.1.0。
why: It turns agent-user coordination into an auditable data object—task state, messages, both parties’ tool actions, observations, verifier components, reward, and termination—while showing why public environments still need version, rights, simulator, and contamination review before trajectories become post-training data.
inclusion_reason: tau2-bench makes the environment-feedback boundary unusually inspectable: released task state, user and agent actions, tool observations, assertion/action checks, scalar outcomes, and both successful and failed episodes expose how coordination failures become evaluable reasoning data.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The stable record begins with arXiv:2506.07982v1, submitted on 2025-06-09, while the archival paper appears in ICML 2026, PMLR 306. The entry id and metadata year therefore preserve the first-publication year, 2025, and the venue records the later archival destination. The official Sierra project page, arXiv and OpenReview records, and the official repository provide the primary sources. Record-level release claims in this Card are frozen to tag v0.1.0, dated 2025-06-12, because the living repository now presents tau3-bench and has changed tasks, evaluators, modes, and splits.

The paper addresses a limitation of customer-service agent benchmarks in which the simulated user only describes a problem while the service agent alone controls the environment. Real interactions can require both parties to act: an agent may change an account in a CRM while the user checks a phone setting or performs a device-side operation. tau2-bench models this as a Dec-POMDP-style dual-control episode. The agent and simulated user exchange natural-language messages, call separate typed tools, observe tool outputs, and jointly change shared state; only one player acts per turn.

The reusable object is more than a dialogue. A task record includes an id, description, structured user scenario and persona, known and unknown information, ticket, initialization data/actions, optional message history, reference actions, environment assertions, communication and natural-language checks, and a reward basis. A released episode binds that specification to ordered assistant/user/tool messages, tool-call arguments and observations, state transitions, timestamps, usage/cost, termination reason, verifier-component outcomes, final scalar reward, trial, and seed. This structure places the paper in environment_agent_trajectory_data: the environment is part of both the generation process and the success test.

The strongest new construction evidence concerns telecom. 15 atomic subtask groups across service, mobile-data, and MMS issues are composed into 2,285 full tasks, from which 114 tasks are sampled for the paper's evaluation. Airline and retail are inherited benchmark domains rather than evidence that the same dual-control construction was applied everywhere. L4-depth coverage is available for the data object, construction pipeline, simulator/environment, feedback contract, released success/failure trajectories, and version risks. The accepted curation_level remains L3_summary_ready; inherited lineage, decontamination, dataset/trajectory rights, external API reproducibility, annotator details, and verifier calibration remain unresolved.

本卡片的稳定书目记录始于 2025 年 6 月 9 日提交的 arXiv:2506.07982v1，正式论文随后收入 ICML 2026、PMLR 306。因此 entry id 与元数据年份保留首次公开年份 2025，venue 则记录后续正式发表信息。官方 Sierra 项目页、arXiv、OpenReview 与官方仓库构成主要来源。卡片中的记录级发布结论固定到 2025 年 6 月 12 日的 v0.1.0 tag，因为持续更新的仓库当前已展示 tau3-bench，并修改了任务、evaluator、运行模式与 split。

论文针对一种客服智能体 benchmark 的局限：模拟用户只负责描述问题，只有客服 agent 能控制环境；但真实服务过程经常要求双方行动，例如 agent 在 CRM 中修改账户的同时，用户检查手机设置或执行设备侧操作。tau2-bench 将这种交互建模为 Dec-POMDP 风格的双控制 episode。agent 与模拟用户交换自然语言消息，调用彼此不同的 typed tool，观察工具输出并共同改变 shared state；每个 turn 只允许一方行动。

可复用对象不只是一段对话。每条 task record 包含 id、description、结构化 user scenario 与 persona、已知和未知信息、ticket、初始化数据与 action、可选 message history、reference action、environment assertion、communication 与 natural-language check，以及 reward basis。发布的 episode 把该任务规范与有序 assistant/user/tool message、tool-call 参数与 observation、state transition、时间戳、usage/cost、termination reason、各 verifier component 结果、最终 scalar reward、trial 和 seed 绑定起来。该结构使论文属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data：环境同时参与轨迹生成与成功判定。

最强的新构造证据来自 telecom。覆盖 service、mobile-data 与 MMS 问题的 15 个 atomic subtask group 被组合为 2,285 个完整任务，论文从中抽取 114 个用于评测。airline 与 retail 是继承的 benchmark domain，不能据此声称所有领域都采用了相同的双控制构造。现有证据可按 L4 深度描述数据对象、构造 pipeline、simulator/environment、反馈契约、发布的成功/失败轨迹及版本风险；已接受的 curation_level 仍保持 L3_summary_ready。继承任务 lineage、去污染、数据/轨迹权利、外部 API 复现性、annotator 细节与 verifier 校准仍未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: tau2-bench turns customer-service evaluation into a dual-control environment where an agent and a tool-using simulated user jointly produce a stateful episode, and releases the tasks, environments, component evaluators, and model-generated trajectories needed to inspect success and failure.

Three objects are coupled. First, a versioned task specifies initial agent/user state, scenario constraints, required or reference actions, and evaluator criteria. Second, an orchestrator alternates the agent and user simulator through messages or single tool calls over separate tool spaces and mutable databases. Third, a mixed feedback contract evaluates the resulting state and trajectory. At benchmark level, components can include DB equivalence, environment/status assertions, action matching, required communication, and natural-language assertions. Selected components are multiplied into a binary-like scalar reward; released RewardInfo preserves the final reward and the component breakdown. Reported telecom tasks primarily use deterministic environment assertions, with an ACTION gate for applicable expected-failure or transfer cases.

This feedback can observe evaluator-visible final state, recorded actions, required communicated facts, and any natural-language claim sent to an enabled assertion judge. It cannot establish that unspecified semantic requirements were satisfied, that a task predicate is complete, or that user-simulator behavior matches a real customer. Conversation termination is also separate from success: STOP, TRANSFER, OUT-OF-SCOPE, maximum-step, or maximum-error termination ends the episode, while reward components decide task success. The metadata's state/action and full-episode granularity describes recorded supervision surfaces, not a dense process reward at every reasoning token.

Relative to the original tau-bench-style single-control setup, the concrete change is that the user gains a tool-constrained state and can perform actions that the agent cannot perform on the user's behalf. Relative to the-agent-company-2024, the chosen depth-calibration Card, tau2-bench concentrates on turn-based customer-service coordination with separate agent/user tool spaces and compositional telecom tasks, rather than a multi-application workplace sandbox with checkpoint scoring. Neither comparison supports a claim that one evaluator is more valid or representative.

For reasoning-data research, the direction signal is the explicit chain task specification -> shared state -> agent/user actions and observations -> component checks -> terminal reward. The official v0.1.0 trajectories retain both successful and failed episodes for inspected runs, enabling verifier and failure audit. The paper uses this chain for evaluation only; later Gym and RL-facing repository features are subsequent software evolution, not evidence of paper-era training use.

一句话贡献是：tau2-bench 把客服评测改造为双控制环境，由 agent 与可调用工具的模拟用户共同生成 stateful episode，并发布任务、环境、组件 evaluator 和模型生成轨迹，使成功与失败都可被检查。

该机制连接三类对象。第一，有版本的 task 指定初始 agent/user state、scenario constraint、required 或 reference action 与 evaluator criterion。第二，orchestrator 让 agent 和 user simulator 通过消息或单次 tool call 交替行动，双方拥有不同 tool space 与可变 database。第三，混合反馈契约检查所得状态与轨迹。在整个 benchmark 层面，component 可包括 DB equivalence、environment/status assertion、action matching、required communication 与 natural-language assertion。选中的 component 相乘形成近似二值 scalar reward；发布的 RewardInfo 保留最终 reward 与 component breakdown。论文报告的 telecom 任务主要使用确定性 environment assertion，并在适用的预期失败或转人工情形加入 ACTION gate。

该反馈可以观察 evaluator 可见的 final state、已记录 action、必须传达的事实，以及启用 assertion judge 时发送给它的 natural-language claim；它不能证明规范未覆盖的语义要求已满足，不能证明 task predicate 完整，也不能保证 user simulator 符合真实客户行为。对话终止与成功判定同样分离：STOP、TRANSFER、OUT-OF-SCOPE、maximum-step 或 maximum-error 会结束 episode，真正的任务成功由 reward component 决定。元数据中的 state/action 与 full-episode granularity 表示可记录的监督表面，不等同于每个推理 token 都有 dense process reward。

相对原始 tau-bench 风格的单控制设置，具体变化是用户获得受工具约束的自身状态，并能执行 agent 无法代替完成的动作。相对本卡片仅用于深度校准的 the-agent-company-2024，tau2-bench 聚焦拥有分离 agent/user tool space 的轮流客服协作与组合式 telecom 任务，而不是带 checkpoint scoring 的多应用工作环境。两项比较都不能证明某个 evaluator 更有效或任务更具代表性。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向信号是显式链条 task specification -> shared state -> agent/user action 与 observation -> component check -> terminal reward。已检查的官方 v0.1.0 run 同时保留成功与失败 episode，支持 verifier 和 failure audit。论文只把这条链用于 evaluation；后续 Gym 与面向 RL 的仓库功能属于之后的软件演化，不能作为论文时代训练用途的证据。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and environment construction. For telecom, the authors first use an undisclosed LLM to draft a product-requirements document, database schema, functions, mock database, and unit tests, then manually refine the package until tests pass. The same LLM-assisted/manual process creates a mocked user-phone database and user tools. Domain-specific agent policies are generated from curated tasks and solutions and jointly refined by humans. The drafting model, exact prompts, sampling parameters, rejection counts, and per-item review history are not disclosed. Airline and retail material is inherited from tau-bench; full per-task upstream lineage is unavailable.

Task generation and selection. Each telecom atomic subtask is implemented as initialization, solution, and assertion functions. Compatible subtasks are composed; the generator executes initialization and solutions, checks final-state assertions, and verifies that all solution functions are necessary. 15 atomic subtask groups produce 2,285 full tasks. The evaluation sampler keeps tasks with at least two subtasks, bins them by intent, subtask count, and persona, and uses Python random.sample to retain at most three per bin; the CLI default seed is 42. The resulting 114-task sample contains 29 service, 36 mobile-data, and 49 MMS tasks spanning 2–9 subtasks, with None, Easy, or Hard persona assignment.

Rollout environment. The orchestrator initializes separate agent CRM and user-phone state plus message history. On each turn, either the evaluated agent or the user simulator emits one natural-language message or one tool call, and the corresponding tool result becomes an observation. Experiments pair gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, o4-mini-2025-04-16, or claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 as agent with gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 as user simulator. The paper uses temperature 0 and four trials per task. Inspected v0.1.0 metadata records max_steps=200, max_errors=10, trial ids, and seeds. Default, No-User, Oracle Plan, and workflow-policy telecom conditions expose coordination and planning ablations.

Verification and output. A task selects reward components from DB, environment/status assertions, communication, natural-language assertions, and action matching. The evaluator computes the selected components and multiplies them; environment assertions are themselves checked individually and multiplied. Termination may result from the simulator's STOP, TRANSFER, or OUT-OF-SCOPE signal or runner guards, but termination alone does not imply success. Each SimulationRun stores its task, ordered messages and tool calls, timing, token/cost metadata, termination reason, RewardInfo, trial, and seed.

Release and use boundary. The paper-era v0.1.0 release contains policies, mock databases, generator/evaluator code, 2,285 full and 114 sampled telecom tasks, and 26 final result JSON files. The inspected GPT-4.1 telecom-default result contains all 456 episodes from 114 tasks times four trials, including 156 reward-1 and 300 reward-0 runs. This is a released evaluation trace set, not a teacher-filtered training corpus. Exact replay should pin v0.1.0, task files, evaluator revision, model endpoint/version, LiteLLM/provider behavior, run configuration, and external credentials. The release has no paper-era train/dev/test split manifest and discloses no decontamination protocol.

输入与环境构造。 对 telecom，作者先用未披露的 LLM 起草 product-requirements document、database schema、function、mock database 与 unit test，再人工修改直到测试通过。模拟 user-phone database 与 user tool 也采用相同的 LLM-assisted/人工流程。domain-specific agent policy 由 LLM 根据整理后的 task 与 solution 生成，并由人工联合修订。起草模型、确切 prompt、采样参数、拒绝数量与逐条 review history 均未披露。airline 与 retail 材料继承自 tau-bench，完整逐任务 upstream lineage 不可用。

任务生成与选择。 每个 telecom atomic subtask 被实现为 initialization、solution 与 assertion function。兼容 subtask 经组合后，generator 执行 initialization 与 solution、检查 final-state assertion，并验证所有 solution function 都是必要的。15 个 atomic subtask group 生成 2,285 个完整任务。评测 sampler 只保留至少包含两个 subtask 的任务，按 intent、subtask count 与 persona 分 bin，再使用 Python random.sample 每个 bin 最多保留三个；CLI 默认 seed 为 42。最终 114 个抽样任务由 29 个 service、36 个 mobile-data 与 49 个 MMS 任务组成，覆盖 2–9 个 subtask，并分配 None、Easy 或 Hard persona。

Rollout 环境。 orchestrator 初始化彼此分离的 agent CRM、user-phone state 与 message history。每个 turn 由被评测 agent 或 user simulator 发出一条自然语言消息或一次 tool call，对应 tool result 随后成为 observation。实验中的 agent model 是 gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14、gpt-4.1-2025-04-14、o4-mini-2025-04-16 或 claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219，user simulator 固定为 gpt-4.1-2025-04-14。论文采用 temperature 0，每个 task 运行四个 trial。已检查的 v0.1.0 metadata 记录 max_steps=200、max_errors=10、trial id 与 seed。Default、No-User、Oracle Plan 与 workflow-policy telecom 条件用于分析协作和规划因素。

验证与输出。 task 可从 DB、environment/status assertion、communication、natural-language assertion 与 action matching 中选择 reward component。evaluator 计算并相乘这些选定 component；environment assertion 也会逐条检查后相乘。episode 可以因 simulator 发出 STOP、TRANSFER、OUT-OF-SCOPE 或 runner guard 而结束，但终止本身不代表成功。每个 SimulationRun 保存 task、有序 message 与 tool call、timing、token/cost metadata、termination reason、RewardInfo、trial 和 seed。

发布与用途边界。 论文时代的 v0.1.0 release 包含 policy、mock database、generator/evaluator code、2,285 个完整和 114 个抽样 telecom task，以及 26 个 final result JSON。已检查的 GPT-4.1 telecom-default 文件保留 114 task 乘四个 trial 的全部 456 个 episode，其中 156 个 reward-1、300 个 reward-0。这是发布的 evaluation trace set，不是经 teacher 筛选的训练语料。准确 replay 应固定 v0.1.0、task file、evaluator revision、model endpoint/version、LiteLLM/provider behavior、run configuration 与外部 credential。论文时代 release 没有 train/dev/test split manifest，也没有披露去污染协议。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Construction-scale evidence is anchored to paper Table 1, Appendix A, and the v0.1.0 JSON release. The telecom generator yields 2,285 full combinations from 15 atomic subtask groups; the released full-task file has 2,285 rows and the sampled evaluation file has 114. Appendix A divides those 114 into 29 service, 36 mobile-data, and 49 MMS tasks covering 2–9 subtasks. The paper reports domain evaluation counts of 50 airline, 115 retail, and 114 telecom, but the pinned release contains 50, 114, and 114 rows. This 1-item retail discrepancy is unresolved and prevents reporting an unqualified single benchmark total.

The evaluation uses four trials per task at temperature 0. On telecom pass^1, the paper reports 34% for GPT-4.1, approximately 42% for o4-mini, and 49% for Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Moving from the No-User condition to Default lowers pass^1 by 18 percentage points for GPT-4.1 and 25 points for o4-mini. These author-reported results support the claim that dual control exposes coordination difficulty under the stated model, simulator, and budget conditions. They do not show that the released trajectories are high-quality training examples, that the evaluator is unbiased, or that the ranking generalizes beyond these APIs and tasks.

The user-simulator audit provides a direct negative signal. Two annotators assess each sampled trace against four criteria. Table 2 reports 3/50 critical telecom errors, 5/50 benign errors, and 8/50 total errors; airline and retail show higher rates. A phrase elsewhere in the paper says there were no critical errors, contradicting the table and surrounding prose. This Card uses the table value, flags the inconsistency, and treats the audit as evidence that simulator failures can become false agent failures rather than as proof that simulation is reliable.

Release evidence is record-level. v0.1.0 contains 26 final result JSON files across model, domain, and ablation combinations. The inspected GPT-4.1 telecom-default file has 456 task-trial episodes: 156 with reward 1 and 300 with reward 0. Each run includes messages, tool calls, component outcomes, termination metadata, trials, and seeds. This confirms success/failure retention for that file, not completeness of every possible run or a uniform data-selection policy.

The repository supports executable inspection but exact closed-model reproduction remains conditional. Code and mock data can be pinned, while external model availability, provider behavior, credentials, and serving revisions can drift. No independent reproduction, adversarial verifier calibration, contamination audit, or training ablation is part of the accepted evidence. Benchmark performance is therefore evidence about measured agent behavior under a fixed configuration, not evidence of data quality.

构造规模证据固定到论文 Table 1、Appendix A 与 v0.1.0 JSON release。telecom generator 从 15 个 atomic subtask group 生成 2,285 个完整组合；发布的 full-task 文件包含 2,285 行，抽样 evaluation 文件包含 114 行。Appendix A 将这 114 个任务分为 29 个 service、36 个 mobile-data 与 49 个 MMS，覆盖 2–9 个 subtask。论文报告的 domain 评测数量为 airline 50、retail 115、telecom 114，但固定版本 release 的行数是 50、114、114。这个相差 1 条的 retail 冲突尚未解决，因此不能在不标版本的情况下报告单一 benchmark 总数。

评测对每个 task 进行四次 trial，temperature 为 0。论文在 telecom pass^1 上报告 GPT-4.1 为 34%、o4-mini 约为 42%、Claude 3.7 Sonnet 为 49%。从 No-User 条件切换到 Default 后，GPT-4.1 的 pass^1 下降 18 个百分点，o4-mini 下降 25 个百分点。这些作者报告的结果支持一个有限结论：在指定模型、simulator 与 budget 条件下，双控制会暴露协作难度。它们不能证明发布轨迹是高质量训练样本，不能证明 evaluator 无偏，也不能证明排序可泛化到其他 API 与任务。

user-simulator audit 提供了直接负面信号。两名 annotator 按四项标准检查每条抽样 trace。Table 2 报告 telecom 有 3/50 个 critical error、5/50 个 benign error、合计 8/50；airline 与 retail 的错误率更高。论文其他位置有一句话声称没有 critical error，这与表格及邻近正文冲突。本卡片采用表格数值并标出不一致，同时把该审计解释为 simulator failure 可能造成 agent false failure 的证据，而不是模拟可靠性的证明。

发布证据达到记录级。v0.1.0 在不同 model、domain 与 ablation 组合下包含 26 个 final result JSON。已检查的 GPT-4.1 telecom-default 文件有 456 个 task-trial episode：156 个 reward 1、300 个 reward 0。每条 run 都包含 message、tool call、component outcome、termination metadata、trial 与 seed。这能确认该文件保留成功和失败样本，不能证明所有可能 run 都完整，也不能证明存在统一的数据选择政策。

仓库支持可执行检查，但闭源模型的准确复现仍有条件。code 与 mock data 可以固定版本，外部 model availability、provider behavior、credential 与 serving revision 仍可能漂移。已接受证据中没有独立复现、对抗性 verifier 校准、污染审计或训练消融。因此 benchmark performance 只能说明固定配置下测得的 agent 行为，不能作为数据质量证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior evaluation pattern inherited from tau-bench gives the service agent tools while the simulated user communicates through dialogue. tau2-bench changes the interaction object by giving the user a separate tool-constrained state and action space. Success can now require coordinated actions across the agent CRM and user phone rather than a one-sided sequence of service actions. The resulting episode records both parties' messages, tool calls, observations, state transitions, component checks, and terminal reward.

The construction contribution is also concrete. Telecom tasks are not authored as 2,285 independent prompts: initialization, solution, and assertion functions implement atomic subtasks, compatibility rules compose them, executable checks reject invalid or prematurely solvable combinations, and a seeded stratified sampler selects 114 evaluation tasks. This creates a reusable mapping from programmatic task structure to natural-language interaction and final-state verification. The undisclosed drafting LLM and manual refinement remain part of the source mixture, so the recipe is not fully automatic or fully reconstructable.

The release boundary adds audit value. v0.1.0 exposes task schemas, mock state, policies, tools, task-generation and evaluator code, the full and sampled telecom sets, and final result files containing successful and failed episodes. The feedback interface is not a single opaque judge score: released records retain the selected basis and component outcomes, although natural-language assertions can still depend on an LLM judge and task predicates can be incomplete.

The work does not newly introduce Dec-POMDPs, tool-calling agents, customer-service simulation, LLM user simulation, programmatic assertions, or terminal rewards individually. Its contribution is their integration into a dual-control benchmark plus compositional telecom construction and a trace-bearing release. Airline and retail are inherited domains, and the paper does not establish equivalent user-tool construction there; later voice, knowledge, Gym, split, and tau3 features are not part of the paper-era novelty.

For reasoning-data research, the directional value is the inspectable environment-feedback boundary: one can connect source task, shared state, two actors' actions, observations, verifier components, reward, and failure mode. Reuse still requires a version pin, task-count reconciliation, rights review, inherited lineage, decontamination policy, simulator audit, predicate calibration, and replay manifest. Scale and benchmark scores are not substitutes for those checks.

继承自 tau-bench 的先前评测模式为客服 agent 提供工具，而模拟用户只通过对话交流。tau2-bench 通过给用户单独的 tool-constrained state 与 action space 改变了交互对象。成功现在可能要求 agent CRM 与 user phone 上的动作协同完成，而不再只是单侧客服 action sequence。所得 episode 记录双方 message、tool call、observation、state transition、component check 与 terminal reward。

构造贡献同样具体。这些 telecom task 不是 2,285 条彼此独立编写的 prompt：initialization、solution 与 assertion function 实现 atomic subtask，compatibility rule 负责组合，可执行检查淘汰无效或提前可解组合，带 seed 的分层 sampler 再选出 114 个 evaluation task。这形成了从程序化 task structure 到自然语言交互及 final-state verification 的可复用映射。未披露的 drafting LLM 与人工修改仍属于 source mixture，因此该 recipe 既非完全自动，也不能完整重建。

发布边界增加了审计价值。v0.1.0 暴露 task schema、mock state、policy、tool、task-generation 与 evaluator code、完整和抽样 telecom 集，以及同时包含成功/失败 episode 的 final result file。反馈接口不是一个不透明的 judge score：发布记录保留 selected basis 与 component outcome；不过 natural-language assertion 仍可能依赖 LLM judge，task predicate 也可能不完整。

该工作没有分别发明 Dec-POMDP、tool-calling agent、客服模拟、LLM user simulation、程序化 assertion 或 terminal reward。贡献在于把它们整合为双控制 benchmark，并加入组合式 telecom 构造与带 trace 的 release。airline 与 retail 是继承 domain，论文没有证明它们采用同等的 user-tool 构造；后续 voice、knowledge、Gym、split 与 tau3 功能不属于论文时代的新意。

对 reasoning-data 研究而言，方向价值来自可检查的 environment-feedback boundary：研究者可以连接 source task、shared state、两个 actor 的 action、observation、verifier component、reward 与 failure mode。复用仍需固定版本、调和任务计数、审查权利、补充继承 lineage 与去污染政策、审计 simulator、校准 predicate 并建立 replay manifest。规模和 benchmark score 不能替代这些检查。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The paper-era release is version-sensitive. v0.1.3 later removed default natural-language assertion checks, v0.2.1 added Gym and train/test splits, and v1.0.0 refactored the system into tau3 while recording many airline/retail fixes and new modes. Current telecom tasks.json contains all 2,285 tasks with a separate base=114 split, whereas v0.1.0 placed the 114-task sample directly in tasks.json. Unpinned tasks, scores, or replay claims are not comparable.
  • Paper Table 1 reports 115 retail tasks while v0.1.0 contains 114. The source of the missing or extra record is unknown. A benchmark total must name whether it comes from the paper or the pinned release.
  • User simulation can produce false failures through premature stopping, omitted constraints, invented details, invalid tool use, or turn-structure violations. Table 2 records 3/50 critical and 5/50 benign telecom errors, contradicting a separate “no critical errors” phrase. The audit sample is small and does not calibrate error rates for every model/domain configuration.
  • Deterministic environment assertions and action gates can miss semantic requirements or reward shortcut state changes; natural-language assertions inherit judge variance and rubric bias. No independent calibration set, adversarial predicate suite, false-positive/false-negative estimate, or reward-hacking study is released. Public tasks, policies, reference actions, and evaluator code also permit benchmark-specific optimization.
  • The generator's LLM identity, prompts, sampling, rejection counts, and item-level review history are undisclosed. Inherited airline/retail task ancestry is incomplete. These gaps prevent reconstruction of the source mixture and selection process even though the telecom composition code is released.
  • v0.1.0 has no train/dev/test split manifest and no disclosed prompt/model-pretraining overlap or decontamination protocol. Public release creates future contamination risk. Later splits cannot be projected backward onto the paper without changing the evaluated artifact.
  • Exact replay depends on closed model APIs, LiteLLM/provider behavior, credentials, serving revisions, and configuration in addition to local code and data. Trial seeds do not freeze external sampling implementations. Reproducing historical model behavior may therefore be impossible even with the paper-era tag.
  • The inspected GPT-4.1 telecom-default file retains 156 successful and 300 failed episodes, but completeness of all possible experiments is not claimed. There is no trajectory-quality filter or training-oriented selection protocol, so the logs should not be treated as curated demonstrations or preference data.
  • The repository root is MIT and the arXiv paper is CC BY 4.0, but no separate dataset/trajectory rights statement covers inherited tau-bench materials, generated model outputs, and all provider terms. Mock customer data reduces direct privacy risk, yet annotator recruitment, compensation, consent, and agreement statistics for the simulator audit are unknown.
  • The paper evaluates agents; it does not report SFT, preference optimization, reward-model training, process supervision, or agent RL. Later Gym/RL interfaces do not retroactively support those uses. Benchmark scores do not establish training-data quality, real-customer validity, or generalization beyond telecom, airline, and retail settings.

• 论文时代 release 对版本高度敏感。v0.1.3 后来移除了默认 natural-language assertion check，v0.2.1 加入 Gym 与 train/test split，v1.0.0 将系统重构为 tau3，并记录大量 airline/retail 修复与新运行模式。当前 telecom tasks.json 包含全部 2,285 个任务，并用独立 base=114 split 表示原样本；v0.1.0 则把 114 个抽样 task 直接放在 tasks.json。未固定版本的 task、score 或 replay 结论不可比较。
  • 论文 Table 1 报告 115 个 retail task，而 v0.1.0 只有 114 个。缺少或新增记录的来源为 unknown。benchmark 总数必须说明取自论文还是固定版本 release。
  • user simulation 可能因过早停止、遗漏约束、编造细节、错误 tool use 或违反 turn structure 造成 false failure。Table 2 记录 telecom 有 3/50 个 critical error 与 5/50 个 benign error，这与另一处“没有 critical error”的表述冲突。audit sample 较小，也没有校准所有 model/domain 配置的错误率。
  • 确定性 environment assertion 与 action gate 可能漏掉语义要求，或奖励 shortcut state change；natural-language assertion 则继承 judge variance 与 rubric bias。发布中没有独立 calibration set、对抗性 predicate suite、false-positive/false-negative 估计或 reward-hacking 研究。公开 task、policy、reference action 与 evaluator code 也允许 benchmark-specific 优化。
  • generator 所用 LLM 身份、prompt、sampling、拒绝数量与逐条 review history 均未披露，继承的 airline/retail task ancestry 也不完整。即使 telecom composition code 已发布，这些空白仍阻止重建 source mixture 与 selection process。
  • v0.1.0 没有 train/dev/test split manifest，也没有披露 prompt/model-pretraining overlap 或去污染协议。公开发布会带来未来污染风险；不能在不改变评测 artifact 的情况下，把后续 split 反向投射到论文。
  • 准确 replay 除本地 code 与 data 外，还依赖闭源 model API、LiteLLM/provider behavior、credential、serving revision 与 configuration。trial seed 不能固定外部 sampling implementation，因此即使使用论文时代 tag，也可能无法重现历史模型行为。
  • 已检查的 GPT-4.1 telecom-default 文件保留 156 个成功和 300 个失败 episode，但没有证据证明所有可能实验都完整。发布中不存在 trajectory-quality filter 或面向训练的 selection protocol，因此这些日志不应被称为整理后的 demonstration 或 preference data。
  • 仓库根目录采用 MIT，arXiv 论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但没有单独的数据/轨迹权利声明覆盖继承的 tau-bench 材料、生成的模型输出与全部 provider term。mock customer data 降低了直接隐私风险，但 simulator audit 的 annotator 招募、报酬、consent 与 agreement statistics 均为 unknown。
  • 论文只评测 agent，没有报告 SFT、preference optimization、reward-model training、process supervision 或 agent RL。后续 Gym/RL interface 不能反向支持这些用途。benchmark score 也不能证明训练数据质量、真实客户有效性，或对 telecom、airline、retail 之外场景的泛化。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, tau2-bench is best used as a version-pinned evaluation and audit substrate. A researcher can connect a structured task and initial shared state to two actors' messages, tool calls and observations, final state, verifier-component outcomes, scalar reward, termination reason, and trial seed. This supports failure attribution across planning, information gathering, agent action, user action, communication, tool execution, simulator behavior, and evaluator mismatch.

The telecom construction pipeline is a practical benchmark recipe. Atomic initialization/solution/assertion functions, compatibility constraints, executable necessity checks, persona assignment, and seeded bin sampling show how to turn a stateful support workflow into many auditable task combinations without authoring each prompt independently. A stronger reuse should additionally log the drafting model and prompts, rejected combinations, per-task review decisions, exact inherited lineage, and immutable release manifests.

The feedback contract is suitable for verifier research. Investigators can mutate final state or action order to test whether environment assertions accept shortcuts, compare action-gated and assertion-only tasks, rerun natural-language assertions with repeated or alternative judges, and use blinded human labels to estimate false positives and false negatives. User-simulator traces can be audited for premature stopping, omitted constraints, invented details, and invalid tool calls. These studies must pin the evaluator revision because later releases changed default assertion behavior.

The retained reward-1 and reward-0 trajectories support failure-retention audits, episode-schema analysis, and replay tooling. The inspected 456-run telecom-default file allows outcome-stratified comparisons of action sequence, message exchange, tool observation, termination, and verifier component. Such work remains evaluation analysis. The paper does not support converting the records into SFT demonstrations, preference pairs, PRM or reward-model data, process supervision, or agent-RL rollouts; missing rights, split, decontamination, lineage, simulator calibration, and external replay dependencies add further blockers.

Safe reuse level is evaluation and audit only, using v0.1.0 or another explicitly named tag plus exact task split, evaluator version, model/provider versions, and run configuration. The current tau3 main branch and later Gym/train-test features are useful follow-on artifacts but are not interchangeable with the paper benchmark. Benchmark scores should be used to compare fixed configurations, not to certify trajectory quality.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，tau2-bench 最适合作为固定版本的 evaluation 与 audit substrate。研究者可以把结构化 task 与初始 shared state 连接到两个 actor 的 message、tool call 与 observation、final state、各 verifier component 结果、scalar reward、termination reason 和 trial seed，从而在 planning、information gathering、agent action、user action、communication、tool execution、simulator behavior 与 evaluator mismatch 之间定位失败来源。

telecom 构造 pipeline 是一套可操作的 benchmark recipe。atomic initialization/solution/assertion function、compatibility constraint、可执行 necessity check、persona assignment 与带 seed 的 bin sampling 展示了如何把 stateful support workflow 转化为大量可审计任务组合，而不必逐条编写 prompt。更完整的复用还应记录 drafting model 与 prompt、被拒组合、逐任务 review decision、准确 inherited lineage 与不可变 release manifest。

反馈契约适合 verifier 研究。研究者可以修改 final state 或 action order，测试 environment assertion 是否接受 shortcut；比较带 action gate 与仅 assertion 的任务；用重复调用或替代 judge 重跑 natural-language assertion；并结合盲评 human label 估计 false positive 与 false negative。user-simulator trace 还可用于审计过早停止、遗漏约束、编造细节与无效 tool call。由于后续 release 改变了默认 assertion 行为，此类研究必须固定 evaluator revision。

保留的 reward-1 与 reward-0 trajectory 支持 failure-retention audit、episode-schema analysis 与 replay tooling。已检查的 456-run telecom-default 文件允许按 outcome 比较 action sequence、message exchange、tool observation、termination 与 verifier component。这些仍属于 evaluation analysis。论文不支持把记录转换为 SFT demonstration、preference pair、PRM 或 reward-model data、process supervision 或 agent-RL rollout；缺少明确权利、split、去污染、lineage、simulator calibration 与外部 replay dependency 也进一步阻断这些用途。

安全复用等级是仅限 evaluation 与 audit，使用 v0.1.0 或其他明确命名的 tag，并同时固定 task split、evaluator version、model/provider version 与 run configuration。当前 tau3 main branch 以及后续 Gym/train-test 功能是有用的后继 artifact，但不能与论文 benchmark 互换。benchmark score 应用于比较固定配置，而不能用于认证 trajectory quality。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the timeline explicit: arXiv v1 is dated 2025-06-09, the closest official release is v0.1.0 from 2025-06-12, and the archival venue is ICML 2026, PMLR 306.
  • Read the 2,285 telecom full combinations and 114 sampled tasks together with the generator: 15 atomic subtask groups are composed, checked, then sampled by intent, subtask count, and persona; the paper reports 115 retail tasks while v0.1.0 contains 114.
  • Separate termination from success. STOP, TRANSFER, OUT-OF-SCOPE, or runner guards end an episode; selected DB/assertion/action/communication/NL components determine reward.
  • Treat the simulator audit as a warning: Table 2 reports 3/50 critical and 5/50 benign telecom errors despite a contradictory “no critical errors” phrase elsewhere.
  • Use the released success/failure traces for version-pinned evaluation and audit only. Later Gym, split, RL, voice, knowledge, and tau3 changes do not retroactively make the paper an agent-training study.

• 必须明确时间线：arXiv v1 日期为 2025 年 6 月 9 日，最接近论文的官方 release 是 2025 年 6 月 12 日的 v0.1.0，正式 venue 则是 ICML 2026、PMLR 306。
  • 应把 2,285 个 telecom 完整组合、114 个抽样任务与 generator 对照阅读：15 个 atomic subtask group 先组合和检查，再按 intent、subtask count 与 persona 抽样；论文报告 115 个 retail task，而 v0.1.0 只有 114 个。
  • 必须区分 termination 与 success。STOP、TRANSFER、OUT-OF-SCOPE 或 runner guard 会结束 episode；选中的 DB/assertion/action/communication/NL component 才决定 reward。
  • simulator audit 应被视为警告：Table 2 报告 telecom 有 3/50 个 critical error 与 5/50 个 benign error，尽管论文另一处出现与之矛盾的“没有 critical error”表述。
  • 发布的成功/失败 trace 只应用于固定版本的 evaluation 与 audit。后续 Gym、split、RL、voice、knowledge 与 tau3 变化不能反向把论文变成 agent-training 研究。

value.html: Versioned customer-service task specifications, executable dual-control environments, and model-generated evaluation episodes with component checks and terminal scalar reward.

The new telecom domain is built from 15 manually refined atomic subtask groups for service, mobile-data, and MMS issues. Airline and retail are verified inherited tau-bench domains. Exact source ancestry for every inherited task and the identities of LLMs used to draft domain materials are undisclosed.
Each player observes messages from the other player or outputs/errors from its available tools; the full release trajectory records assistant, user, and tool messages.

A multi-turn Tool-Agent-User episode in which the agent and simulated user alternate natural-language messages or single tool calls over shared mutable state until a stop/transfer/out-of-scope or guard termination.

The evaluated agent model and a GPT-4.1-2025-04-14 function-calling user simulator jointly generate episodes through the orchestrator; released v0.1.0 result files are evaluation trajectories, not human demonstrations.

items: tool-call name, arguments, requestor, and tool observation

value.html: A LiteLLM-backed orchestrator implementing a Dec-POMDP-style shared world with separate agent CRM and user-phone state, domain policies, typed tools, mock databases, and unit-tested environment code.

A task selects components from DB equivalence, environment/status assertions, required communication, natural-language assertions, and action matching. Selected components are multiplied into a binary-like scalar reward. Reported telecom tasks primarily use deterministic environment assertions, with an ACTION gate for some expected-failure/transfer cases.
The released RewardInfo stores final reward, DB match, per-assertion, per-action, communication, and NL-assertion checks, selected reward basis, and component breakdown.

Conversation termination and task success are distinct. The user simulator can emit STOP, TRANSFER, or OUT-OF-SCOPE and the runner has maximum-step/error guards; success is the product of the task-selected verifier components over final state and/or trajectory.

Official v0.1.0 includes airline, retail, telecom, and mock task/environment data; 2,285 full and 114 sampled telecom task records; evaluator and generator code; policies/databases; and 26 final JSON result files with full trajectories for reported model/domain/ablation combinations.

LLM-assisted domain code/policy drafting and manual refinement -> atomic initialization/solution/assertion functions -> seeded compositional task generation -> sampled evaluation task -> agent/user/tool episode -> component checks and scalar reward.
Not a training recipe. Evaluated agents are gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, o4-mini-2025-04-16, and claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219.
unknown

An undisclosed LLM drafts PRDs, schemas, implementations, tests, and policies; authors manually refine them. Telecom tasks are then generated compositionally from initialization, solution, and assertion functions. Episodes are generated by each evaluated agent paired with the GPT-4.1 user simulator.
Telecom technical-support intents and manually refined atomic subtask groups; verified airline and retail tasks inherited from tau-bench. Per-task upstream source lineage is incomplete.

The telecom generator keeps composite tasks with at least two subtasks, bins by intent, number of subtasks, and persona, and samples at most three per bin. The released experiment runs each selected task four times.
Turn-based function-calling orchestration over separate agent/user tool spaces and mutable databases; Default, No-User, Oracle Plan, and workflow-policy ablations are provided for telecom.
At most three telecom tasks per intent × subtask-count × persona bin; default generator seed 42. This is evaluation-set sampling, not trajectory selection for training.

Task correctness is checked by applying initialization and solution functions, verifying final assertions, and verifying that the task is not solved before all solution functions are applied. The evaluation subset is balanced by intent/subtask-count/persona bins through seeded random sampling.
gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 with temperature 0, constrained to one message or requested tool call per turn and grounded in tool-observable state.

Paper reports four trials per task. Inspected v0.1.0 result metadata uses max_steps=200 and max_errors=10; a one-trial run over all domains is reported to cost about USD 40 for the specified API setup.

Verified inherited airline/retail task suites plus a new LLM-assisted, manually refined, programmatically composed telecom domain over mock CRM and phone state; released trajectories come from four evaluated agent models and a GPT-4.1 user simulator.

v0.1.0 exposes evaluation task files but no train/dev/test split manifest. The paper reports 50 airline, 115 retail, and 114 sampled telecom tasks, while v0.1.0 contains 50 airline, 114 retail, and 114 telecom rows. Train/test splits were added only in v0.2.1.
No systematic prompt/model-pretraining overlap audit is disclosed. Public tasks, policies, evaluator code, and reference actions create future exposure and benchmark-specific optimization risk.
unknown

The inspected official GPT-4.1 telecom-default file retains all 456 task-trial episodes, including 156 reward-1 and 300 reward-0 runs. v0.1.0 has 26 final result JSON files, but completeness beyond published configurations is not claimed.
